The '''Pashvi system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. It was the home system of the [[Pashvi/Legends|Pashvi species]].<ref name="Atlas" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />
